configure_awq_quantization: configure AWQ W4A16 quantization with group_size=32 and MSE observer on a Qwen3-VL model
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply one-shot AWQ quantization to a Qwen3-VL model using calibration dataset and data collator
preprocess_vision_language_dataset: preprocess a vision-language dataset with chat template tokenization and pixel value handling
generate_text_after_quantization: generate text from a quantized Qwen3-VL model using dispatch_model and model.generate
save_quantized_model: save a quantized Qwen3-VL model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format
